problem_or_opportunity: The v1 32-run-card outline identified the right stages but was not sufficiently executable, and manual prompt selection would still create Founder routing burden.
proposed_mechanism: Thirty-two full production prompt contracts plus an A00 rule-based Router that selects the smallest applicable prompt from normalized CURRENT state, enforces P1/P2 priority, permits only safe independent parallelism and recomputes the next route after PASS.
expected_benefit: Turns Self-Improvement v2 from policy into a repeatable production operating layer while reducing manual prompt selection and preventing lower-priority meta-work from starving books/audio.

acceptance_conditions: Router chooses smallest correct prompt from persisted state
prompt does not restart solved work
outputs are consumable by downstream stage
auto-continue stops only at a real gate
parallel routes are dependency-independent and rebase before write
